title: Happy birthday text
situation: It's your friend's birthday and you text them to say happy birthday and figure out how to celebrate.
tip: For a birthday text, lead with the wish (생일 축하해!) then add a follow-up like 선물 뭐 받고 싶어? — friends keep it warm by moving toward an actual celebration.

turns.ko: 헐 너 내 생일 기억하고 있었어? ㅋㅋㅋ
turns.en: Whoa you remembered my birthday? lol

turns.prompt: Say of course, wish them happy birthday warmly

choices.ko: 당연하지 ㅋㅋ 생일 진짜 축하해!! 🎂
choices.en: Of course lol happy birthday for real!! 🎂
choices.feedback: 당연하지 + 생일 축하해 is the warm, natural birthday opener friends use.

choices.ko: 귀하의 생신을 진심으로 경축드립니다.
choices.en: I sincerely congratulate you on your birthday.
choices.feedback: 생신/경축드립니다 is honorific, for elders or formal cards — way too stiff for a friend.

choices.ko: 응 오늘이 며칠이지?
choices.en: Yeah, what's the date today?
choices.feedback: Doesn't actually wish them anything and changes the subject — kills the moment.

turns.ko: 고마워 ㅠㅠ 챙겨주는 사람 너밖에 없다 진짜
turns.en: Thank you ㅠㅠ you're literally the only one who looks out for me

turns.prompt: Brush it off sweetly and ask what they want as a gift

choices.ko: 에이 무슨 ㅋㅋ 선물 뭐 받고 싶어? 말만 해
choices.en: Aw come on lol what do you wanna get? just say the word
choices.feedback: 에이 무슨 deflects the compliment cutely, and the gift question moves it forward.

choices.ko: 선물 구매는 예산 범위 내에서 검토하겠습니다.
choices.en: I'll review the gift purchase within the budget range.
choices.feedback: Reads like a purchase order — corporate phrasing nobody texts a friend.

choices.ko: 맞아 내가 너 진짜 잘 챙기지.
choices.en: True, I really do take good care of you.
choices.feedback: Self-congratulating instead of reacting warmly — comes off cocky and dead-ends it.

turns.ko: 음 딱히 없는데 ㅋㅋ 그냥 너랑 맛있는 거 먹고 싶어
turns.en: Hmm nothing really lol I just wanna eat something good with you

turns.prompt: React happily and offer to treat them

choices.ko: 오 콜 ㅋㅋ 오늘 생일이니까 내가 쏠게! 뭐 먹을까?
choices.en: Oh deal lol it's your birthday so it's on me! what should we eat?
choices.feedback: 콜 + 내가 쏠게 is exactly how a friend offers to treat, plus a question keeps it rolling.

choices.ko: 식대는 더치페이로 정산하는 것이 합리적입니다.
choices.en: Splitting the bill is the rational way to settle the cost.
choices.feedback: 정산/합리적 is accountant-speak — bizarrely cold on someone's birthday.

choices.ko: 나도 맛있는 거 먹고 싶어.
choices.en: I wanna eat something good too.
choices.feedback: Just mirrors them with no offer or plan — the chat stalls.

turns.ko: 헐 진짜?? 완전 좋아 ㅋㅋ 고기 어때 고기!
turns.en: Whoa really?? love it lol how about meat, meat!

turns.prompt: Agree and lock down when to meet

choices.ko: ㅋㅋㅋ 역시 생일엔 고기지 그럼 이따 7시에 볼까?
choices.en: Lol meat is a must on your birthday so wanna meet at 7 later?
choices.feedback: Playful agreement plus pinning the time turns the plan real — perfect close.

choices.ko: 육류 섭취 일정을 추후 통보드리겠습니다.
choices.en: I'll notify you of the meat-consumption schedule later.
choices.feedback: Sounds like an office memo — totally wrong register for a birthday plan.

choices.ko: 선물 뭐 받고 싶어?
choices.en: What do you wanna get as a gift?
choices.feedback: You already covered the gift earlier — looping back stalls the plan.

title: Congrats on the new job
situation: Your friend just texted that they finally got hired after a long job hunt, and you celebrate with them.
tip: For big news, react big first (대박/축하해!) before any questions. After a long job hunt, acknowledging the grind (고생했어) hits harder than just 'congrats'.

turns.en: Hey I finally landed a job!!! ㅠㅠㅠ

choices.ko: 헐 대박!!! 진짜 축하해 ㅠㅠ 고생했어 진짜
choices.en: Whoa amazing!!! congrats for real ㅠㅠ you worked so hard
choices.feedback: 대박 + 축하해 + 고생했어 nails the big reaction and honors the long grind.

choices.ko: 취업을 진심으로 축하드리는 바입니다.
choices.en: I hereby sincerely congratulate you on your employment.
choices.feedback: 축하드리는 바입니다 is ceremonial/written language — way too stiff for a hyped friend.

choices.ko: 오 어디 회사인데?
choices.en: Oh which company?
choices.feedback: Jumps to questions without celebrating first — feels cold for huge news.

turns.ko: ㅠㅠ 진짜 면접을 몇 번이나 봤는지 몰라. 너무 오래 걸렸어
turns.en: ㅠㅠ I lost count of how many interviews I had. It took so long.

turns.prompt: Acknowledge how hard it was and ask which company

choices.ko: ㅠㅠ 알지 알지 진짜 고생 많았어 어느 회사야??
choices.en: ㅠㅠ I know I know you went through so much which company is it??
choices.feedback: Empathizes (고생 많았어) then asks the natural follow-up — keeps it flowing.

choices.ko: 구직 활동의 노고를 충분히 이해하는 바입니다.
choices.en: I fully understand the toils of your job-seeking efforts.
choices.feedback: 노고/이해하는 바입니다 sounds like an award speech — robotic for a close friend.

choices.ko: 면접 그렇게 많이 봤어?
choices.en: You did that many interviews?
choices.feedback: Just repeats their line back as a question instead of reacting — sounds odd.

turns.ko: 그 IT 회사! 나 다음 달부터 출근이야 ㅋㅋㅋ
turns.en: That IT company! I start next month lol

turns.prompt: React and tease them lightly about a celebration

choices.ko: 와 미쳤다 ㅋㅋ 이건 한턱 쏴야 되는 거 알지?
choices.en: Wow that's insane lol you know you gotta treat me, right?
choices.feedback: 와 미쳤다 + the playful 한턱 쏴야 is exactly how friends tease over good news.

choices.ko: 입사 후 첫 급여일에 식사를 제공해 주시기 바랍니다.
choices.en: Please provide a meal on your first payday after joining.
choices.feedback: Reads like a formal request memo — kills the playful vibe completely.

choices.ko: IT 회사는 야근이 많대.
choices.en: I heard IT companies have a lot of overtime.
choices.feedback: Negative and off-topic — deflates their happy news instead of celebrating.

turns.ko: ㅋㅋㅋ 당연하지 내가 거하게 쏜다 뭐 먹고 싶어?
turns.en: Lol of course I'll treat you big time what do you wanna eat?

turns.prompt: Happily accept and suggest meeting up to celebrate

choices.ko: 오예 ㅋㅋ 그럼 이번 주말에 만나서 제대로 축하하자!
choices.en: Yess lol let's meet this weekend and celebrate properly then!
choices.feedback: Excited yes plus 만나서 축하하자 turns the chat into a real plan — great close.

choices.ko: 메뉴 및 일정은 별도 협의 후 확정하겠습니다.
choices.en: The menu and schedule will be finalized after separate consultation.
choices.feedback: 협의/확정하겠습니다 is meeting-minutes language — totally off for friends.

choices.ko: 고생했어 진짜.
choices.en: You really worked hard.
choices.feedback: You already said this earlier — repeating it ignores their offer and stalls.

title: Weather and small talk
situation: You're hanging out with a friend and start chatting about how nice the weather's been lately.
tip: Weather is the easiest small-talk opener. Agree (그치/그러니까), add a tiny opinion, then pivot to a plan — that's how casual chat turns into actually doing something.

turns.ko: 와 오늘 날씨 진짜 미쳤다 완전 봄이네
turns.en: Wow the weather today is insane, totally spring

turns.prompt: Agree and add how you feel about it

choices.ko: 그러니까 ㅋㅋ 이런 날엔 막 어디 나가고 싶어
choices.en: Right lol on days like this I just wanna go somewhere
choices.feedback: 그러니까 agrees, then a little opinion opens the door to a plan — very natural.

choices.ko: 금일 기온은 평년 대비 다소 높은 편입니다.
choices.en: Today's temperature is somewhat above the seasonal average.
choices.feedback: Sounds like a weather broadcast — way too formal for chatting with a friend.

choices.ko: 응 날씨 좋네.
choices.en: Yeah, nice weather.
choices.feedback: Agrees but adds nothing — flat and the small talk just dies.

turns.ko: ㅋㅋㅋ 그치 요즘 집에만 있기 너무 아까워
turns.en: Lol right it feels like such a waste to just stay home these days

turns.prompt: Strongly agree and relate it to yourself

choices.ko: 헐 인정 ㅋㅋ 나도 주말 내내 집에만 있었잖아
choices.en: Ugh facts lol I literally stayed home all weekend too
choices.feedback: 헐 인정 is super natural agreement, and relating back makes it feel mutual.

choices.ko: 외출 자제는 건강 관리에 도움이 됩니다.
choices.en: Refraining from going out helps with health management.
choices.feedback: Reads like a public-health notice — bizarrely stiff and off-topic.

choices.ko: 넌 집에만 있는 게 좋아?
choices.en: Do you like staying home?
choices.feedback: Slightly contrary and shifts focus onto them — breaks the agreeing flow.

turns.ko: ㅋㅋㅋ 우리 둘 다 집에만 있었네 진짜
turns.en: Lol, we've both been staying home all this time.

turns.prompt: Laugh it off and suggest going out somewhere

choices.ko: ㅋㅋㅋ 맞아 근데 오늘은 나가자 한강 갈래?
choices.en: Lol true but let's go out today, wanna hit the Han River?
choices.feedback: Agrees with a laugh then pitches 한강 갈래? — turns small talk into a plan.

choices.ko: 야외 활동을 적극 권장하는 바입니다.
choices.en: I strongly recommend outdoor activities.
choices.feedback: 권장하는 바입니다 sounds like a brochure — not how friends suggest hanging out.

choices.ko: 집순이가 무슨 뜻이야?
choices.en: What does homebody mean?
choices.feedback: Derails into a definition question instead of riding the easy vibe.

turns.ko: 오 한강 좋다!! 가서 치맥 하자 ㅋㅋ
turns.en: Oh the Han River sounds great!! let's get chicken and beer there lol

turns.prompt: Get hyped and say let's head out now

choices.ko: 오 완전 콜 ㅋㅋ 날씨도 좋은데 지금 바로 가자!
choices.en: Oh totally deal lol weather's nice so let's go right now!
choices.feedback: 콜 + 지금 바로 가자 locks the plan with great energy — a perfect close.

choices.ko: 치킨과 맥주 섭취 후 귀가 시간을 정하시지요.
choices.en: Let us set a return time after consuming chicken and beer.
choices.feedback: Over-formal and weirdly logistical — sucks all the fun out of it.

choices.ko: 날씨 진짜 좋다 그치?
choices.en: The weather's really nice huh?
choices.feedback: Loops back to the opening weather line instead of moving on the plan.
